concerns.text: T008 emits data/results/computational_efficiency.json with a pass flag for 'the pipeline' (SC-004), but T009 — the full-scale run that the flag should measure — executes AFTER T008. As ordered, the efficiency JSON would reflect a partial (Phase-1/2-scale) run, or T009 must silently regenerate it. State explicitly that T009's full run re-emits/updates computational_efficiency.json so the pass flag corresponds to the full pipeline.

T003's VIF fallback clause ('fall back to PCA ... with a Ridge model on the components') describes training a model, which overlaps T004's training scope and leaves ambiguous whether the Ridge-on-PCA model is trained in T003 or T004. Clarify that T003 only selects/applies the feature transformation and the Ridge fit occurs in T004, or move the Ridge training explicitly into T004.
